admin.title: Create your admin account
admin.description: This is the first account on this Synthseek install. You can invite others later.
admin.createError: Could not create the admin account. Please try again.

slskd.title: Connect to slskd
slskd.description: Synthseek talks to the Soulseek network through your slskd daemon. This step is required.
slskd.failed: Could not reach slskd. Check the URL and API key.
slskd.overrideArmed: Continuing without a verified connection. You can fix this later in Settings.
slskd.saveFailed: Could not save the slskd connection. Confirm the URL and API key, then try again.

plex.title: Connect Plex (optional)
plex.description: Lets Synthseek scan your library after each import and mirror playlists. You can do this later from Settings.
plex.blockedHint: Connect Plex or skip this step to continue
plex.intro: A popup will open for you to sign in to plex.tv.
plex.connected: Plex connected. Continue to the next step.
plex.noServers: No Plex servers were found on this account. You can skip and add one later.
plex.timeout: Plex sign-in timed out. Try again, or skip and connect Plex later from Settings.
plex.popupUnfinished: Plex sign-in did not finish. Reopen the popup and approve access, or skip this step.
plex.serverPickerIntro: Pick the Plex server Synthseek should target:

enrichment.title: Metadata enrichment (optional)
enrichment.description: Improves how Synthseek labels, scores, and recommends tracks. All keys are optional but recommended.
enrichment.saveFailed: Could not save your settings. Check the details and try again.
enrichment.lastfmHint: System-wide Last.fm API key. Shared across all users.
enrichment.songlinkHint: Resolves track URLs across platforms for cross-platform playlist imports. Synthseek uses the public endpoint by default. Leave blank unless you have a key.
enrichment.acoustidHint: Audio fingerprinting fallback for tracks without reliable tag metadata.
enrichment.musicbrainzHint: Required. Without it, Synthseek shares rate-limited email.

done.title: You're all set
done.description: Synthseek is ready to go. You can adjust everything later under Settings.
done.cardBody: Slskd is wired up. Plex and metadata enrichment can be added or edited any time.
done.failed: Could not finish setup. Please try again.
